results.text: The sex-specific effects of sodium alginate with varying viscosities on lipid metabolism and gut microbiota in rats. Sodium alginate (SA), a dietary fiber, is known to influence lipid metabolism and gut microbiota. However, its long-term effects of viscosity/dose and sex-specific differences remain underexplored.
